high_level_overview.overview: This JCL job, **DUSRSECJ**, creates and populates a User Security file for the CardDemo application, which manages user authentication data. It establishes records for 5 administrative users and 5 regular users, each containing a user ID, first name, last name, and password. The job accomplishes this through a three-step process: creating a flat sequential file (PS) from in-stream user data, defining a VSAM KSDS cluster to serve as the permanent indexed security store, and copying the sequential data into the VSAM file for efficient keyed access.

parameters.name: JOB
parameters.description: The accounting information or job description string passed to the system. It identifies the job and may be used for billing or tracking purposes.

parameters.name: REGION
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum amount of virtual storage (8 megabytes) available to the entire job for execution. This limits memory usage across all job steps.

parameters.name: CLASS
parameters.description: Assigns the job to input job class 'A', which determines the job entry subsystem (JES) queue where the job waits for execution and can influence scheduling priority and resource allocation.

parameters.name: MSGCLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the output class 'H' for the job log and system messages. This determines where the job's JCL listing, allocation messages, and other system output are routed after job completion.

parameters.name: NOTIFY
parameters.description: Instructs the system to send a notification message to the submitting user (resolved from the symbolic parameter &SYSUID) when the job completes, informing them of the job's completion status.

job_details.purpose: Pre-deletion step that deletes the existing user security Physical Sequential (PS) dataset before recreation, ensuring a clean state for subsequent steps.

Creates a new Physical Sequential (PS) user security file by writing in-stream data records containing user credentials (user ID, first name, last name, and password) for both admin and regular users.
job_details.inputs: SYSUT1 (in-stream data: 10 user records including ADMIN001–ADMIN005 and USER0001–USER0005 with names and passwords, fixed at 80 bytes each)
job_details.outputs: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.USRSEC.PS (new cataloged PS dataset, LRECL=80, RECFM=FB, DSORG=PS, BLKSIZE=0, allocated on SYSAD with 10 primary and 5 secondary tracks); SYSPRINT (utility messages to SYSOUT)

job_details.purpose: Defines a new VSAM Key-Sequenced Dataset (KSDS) for user security by first deleting any existing version and then creating the cluster with specified key, record size, and space parameters.
job_details.inputs: SYSIN (IDCAMS control statements: DELETE AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.USRSEC.VSAM.KSDS, SET MAXCC=0, DEFINE CLUSTER with KEYS(8,0), RECORDSIZE(80,80), REUSE, INDEXED, TRACKS(45,15), FREESPACE(10,15), CISZ(8192))
job_details.outputs: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.USRSEC.VSAM.KSDS (VSAM KSDS cluster), AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.USRSEC.VSAM.KSDS.DAT (data component), AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.USRSEC.VSAM.KSDS.IDX (index component); SYSPRINT (utility messages to SYSOUT)

job_details.purpose: Copies the user security records from the Physical Sequential (PS) flat file into the newly defined VSAM KSDS file using the IDCAMS REPRO command.
job_details.inputs: IN: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.USRSEC.PS (source PS dataset, DISP=SHR); SYSIN (REPRO INFILE(IN) OUTFILE(OUT) command)
job_details.outputs: OUT: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.USRSEC.VSAM.KSDS (target VSAM KSDS populated with user security records, DISP=SHR); SYSPRINT, SYSOUT (utility messages to SYSOUT)

data_operations.description: Pre-delete step using IEFBR14 to delete the existing sequential dataset AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.USRSEC.PS via MOD,DELETE,DELETE disposition
IEBGENER reads 10 in-stream user security records containing user ID, first name, last name, and password fields (80-byte fixed records)
IEBGENER creates and writes the new sequential dataset AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.USRSEC.PS with LRECL=80, RECFM=FB, cataloged on SYSAD unit with 10 primary and 5 secondary tracks
IDCAMS deletes the existing VSAM KSDS cluster AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.USRSEC.VSAM.KSDS if it exists; MAXCC is set to 0 to suppress non-zero return code if dataset does not exist

IDCAMS defines a new VSAM KSDS cluster AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.USRSEC.VSAM.KSDS with key length 8 at offset 0, record size 80, REUSE, INDEXED, 45 primary and 15 secondary tracks, 10% CI and 15% CA freespace, CISZ 8192, with data component AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.USRSEC.VSAM.KSDS.DAT and index component AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.USRSEC.VSAM.KSDS.IDX
IDCAMS REPRO reads the sequential dataset AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.USRSEC.PS as input (INFILE IN) for copying to the VSAM file
IDCAMS REPRO copies all records from AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.USRSEC.PS into the VSAM KSDS cluster AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.USRSEC.VSAM.KSDS (OUTFILE OUT), loading the 10 user security records into the keyed dataset
